description: One child has an infusion that is started during a general anaesthetic and never stopped.

expectations.says: The infusion is written as one period, which ends when the anaesthetic ends.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS periods, SUM(CASE WHEN d.drug_exposure_end_datetime = vd.visit_detail_end_datetime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ending_with_anaesthetic FROM omop.drug_exposure d JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = d.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001131'
